text:
Ana: Postmortem live — repeated tail latency during customer peak windows. Need owners for SLO follow-ups and a short remediation timeline.
Vik: numbers?
Ana: p95 ~220ms, p99 normally ~430ms but observed spikes up to 1.7s across two evenings. Error-budget burns concentrated Tue/Thu 17:30-19:00.
Tarek: i'd prefer we avoid changing customer-facing p99 for now. suggest we add a "burst tolerance" SLI (p999 over 5m) and operational mitigations first.
Vik: agree. mitigation ideas: early deprioritization for non-interactive work, route heavy requests to quantized models when queue depth and inflight exceed thresholds, and add short throttles before full fallback.
Tarek: config sketch: ```yaml
serving:
  fallback: quantized-v1
  guards:
    queue_ms_threshold: 350
    inflight_threshold: 30
  deprioritize_labels: ["batch", "low-priority"]
  throttles:
    p95_queue_ms: 120
```
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget_burn=0.39 over 24h; spike windows detected Tue 17:20-18:15, Thu 17:40-18:05. Link: https://console.redwood/slo/xyz
Jules: i'll own dashboards. will add panels: p95, p99, p999-burst(5m), burn-rate by weekday/hour, queue depth heatmap, and annotate incident spans.
Ana: action list and owners: 1) Burst SLI + dashboard panels — Jules — due 2026-04-27. 2) Routing guard + throttles PR — Vik — due 2026-04-23. 3) Canary test plan (48h synthetic peak with kv-cache metrics) — Tarek — due 2026-05-05. 4) Postmortem follow-up doc with acceptance/rollback criteria — Ana — due 2026-04-29.
Vik: i'll start the PR today and tag @ops. will include unit tests for the matcher.
Jules: dashboard PR by EOD Monday, will pin postmortem link and add a small explainer for the burst SLI.
Tarek: requesting canary infra reservations and test harness. will post test steps to the follow-up doc.
Ana: we will not change SLA now. deploy guards + dashboards, monitor for 2 weeks, then revisit SLO change only if mitigation insufficient. i'll create a tracker card and ping owners daily. :thumbsup:
